title: Synthetic-data-gen-using-SDV
summary: A small Python script that generates synthetic tabular data from an uploaded CSV, using SDV's SingleTableMetadata to infer schema and combining synthesis with a Gemini-based PII generator. The script directly imports and runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic records from the source data.
evidence: synthesize.py:28 'synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata)' followed by fit/sample calls
